meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 里的本地模型,把提示词发给指定模型并拿回回答。它可把部分任务交给本地模型,自己继续当总指挥。
howto.when: 当你说“用 atomic chat……”或要求调用本地模型时,Claude 会先列出可用模型,再选一个生成答案。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会列出模型并用其中一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里可用的模型

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains two tools: list Atomic Chat models and send prompts to a model for a response. It can offload tasks to local models while staying the orchestrator.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Atomic Chat or local models, e.g. 'use atomic chat to...'. Claude lists available models, then picks one to generate.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models and generates an answer.

say_en.text: List the models available in atomic chat.
Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: what is quantum computing?
say_en.note: Sends the prompt to that model.
